title: Production-grade rayx-signalr: typed errors, all transports, proxies, refreshable auth, suspension-aware liveness, proven TLS paths, reference-class performance, and stretch SOCKS/PAC/OS proxies, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3

checks.descriptionMarkdown: New `hot_paths` Criterion benchmarks run once each in test mode (every id executes and succeeds).

sprints.title: Measurement: micro-benchmarks, reference-client performance harness, sequence tracing

tasks.title: Criterion hot-path benchmarks
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `criterion` (dev), the non-default `bench-internals` feature with `#[doc(hidden)] pub mod bench_support` exposing the current codec/storage entry points, and `benches/hot_paths.rs` with the stable ids of R1.C1 over pre-built frames for every message type, protocol and payload size. Do not change hot-path code in this sprint: S3 saves its baseline from this state.

tasks.title: Aspire performance harness with the official .NET client
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `PerfHub` to the test service, the `perf` test-false binary in `tests/perf` (one workload per run, JSON result line, release build), `dotnet/RayX.SignalR.PerfReference` (official client, same CLI), the `Performance` category in the E2E project (interleaved rounds, median, `artifacts-temp/perf/<run>.json`, `RAYX_SIGNALR_PERF_WORKLOADS`/`RAYX_SIGNALR_PERF_SCALE`), and add the new project to `RayX.SignalR.slnx`. Performance tests never run in the ordinary E2E selection.

tasks.title: Stateful sequence instrumentation
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `debug` sequencing records of D3 to `stateful.rs` and the reconnect/resume paths on both targets (generation, tracked/received ids, duplicates, Acks, Sequence, resend range; no payloads), and the `sequence_trace_` unit group with a capturing logger.

tasks.title: Error type and classification
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `src/error.rs` per D12 (`Error`, `ErrorKind`, structured accessors, `is_transient`, `Arc` sources, redaction at construction) with `thiserror`, and the `error_model_` group.

tasks.title: Typed public API on both targets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Replace every `String` error on paths reaching the public API (client, invocations, streams, lifecycle, configuration validation, handlers via `ReconnectionHandler::reason()`, TLS/Android initialization) on native and wasm; add `tests/public_error_types.rs`.

tasks.title: Error-kinds scenario and test migration
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the service endpoints needed by `error-kinds` (throwing hub method, unknown path, hang endpoint if not yet present, close-with-error) and the scenario in `tests/e2e` and the wasm fixture; migrate existing scenarios and unit tests from string matching to kinds; prove the whole WebSocket catalog on native and Chromium.

tasks.title: Error documentation and major version
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Errors chapter (`docs/11-errors-and-logging.md`) with the migration section, per-item error docs, next major version in `Cargo.toml` per R12.C4.

tasks.title: Disconnect stops every handle (StopAsync parity)

Review repair S2-F1: the native action storage releases its map lock before an action runs (each action has its own lock, as the browser storage already did), so `disconnect`/`register`/`unregister` inside a callback return; `disconnect_` covers it and the last-handle drop, and `disconnect-every-handle` has a server-triggered callback that disconnects.

sprints.title: Hot-path optimization: single-pass codec, quiet logging, panic-free parsing

tasks.title: Single-pass inbound and typed outbound codec
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Run the required `s3-micro-budget` baseline first (saves `pre-optimization`). Implement `protocol::codec` per D2 (`serde_json` `raw_value`, MessagePack marker reads without `rmpv` trees), route storage/actions/callbacks through `InboundMessage`, make outbound messages typed with reused buffers and shared `Bytes`, remove `json_frame` re-parsing, and add the `wire_codec_` group. Golden frame tests stay unchanged. Review repair S3-F4: a malformed Close still closes without reconnect permission (JSON and MessagePack), and the compact JSON path reports a completion that carries both a result and an error as the server's error, as the general decode does.

tasks.title: Payload-free logging
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Remove payloads from every record above `trace` on both targets (completions, stream items, invocations, callbacks, frames) and add the `log_policy_` capturing-logger test.

tasks.title: Panic-free parsing and property tests
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `proptest` (dev), module-level `#![deny(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic, clippy::indexing_slicing)]` (outside `cfg(test)`) to the protocol, transport and negotiation modules, fix every finding, and add the `robustness_` property group. Review repair S3-F5: the denials also cover `communication/common.rs` and `communication/reconnection.rs` (its coordinator lock recovers from poisoning), and `s3-panic-lints-wasm` lints the browser build.

tasks.title: Meet the micro and reference-client budgets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `MicroBenchmarkBudget` and `ReferenceClientBudget` categories. Profile (release, `cargo flamegraph` or `perf` where available) and remove remaining per-message costs until R2.C3 and R2.C4 hold: e.g. avoid per-message `String` allocation for ids, avoid channel hops between receiver and storage, batch writer flushes, size buffers from the frame length. If a budget proves unreachable for a measured, explained reason, amend the criterion with that evidence rather than weakening silently. Finding (2026-10-07, quick-scale reference run): `send-throughput` reached 0.075x of the .NET client because every send waited for its own socket write and flush; R2.C5 adopts the .NET acceptance semantics and writer coalescing (`outbound_writer_`). JSON stream items and result completions in ASP.NET Core's compact shape decode their payload in one pass with the record (`wire_codec_`). `bench_support`'s JSON frame builders wrote members alphabetically (`serde_json::json!`), not in ASP.NET Core's order as documented; they now write ASP.NET Core's order. The pre-optimization parser's cost does not depend on member order, so the saved baseline stays comparable. Review repairs: S3-F1 the outbound queue is Tokio's bounded channel with a shared `reserve()`, so every handle feels its capacity; S3-F2 the replay-buffer wait runs on the connection's runtime; S3-F3 coalesced messages stay within 64 KiB (`next_batch`); S3-F6 pending actions are shared and decode before any lock, browser callbacks run without a borrow.

tasks.title: Invocation ids and MessagePack argument fidelity
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: On top of the single-pass codec: per-connection invocation ids in a map separate from callbacks (R16.C12) and callback arguments decoded from the original MessagePack values (R16.C10), with the `invocation_ids_` and `callback_msgpack_args_` groups and the `msgpack-fidelity` scenario (test hub callback with `byte[]`, `DateTime` and `Dictionary<int,string>`; native, fixture, Android). The scenario catalog gains per-scenario protocols (`Scenario.Protocols`), so `msgpack-fidelity` is MessagePack only; a Catalog test covers the filter.

Review repairs: P1-F1 panics in typed callbacks and asynchronous factories are caught; P1-F3 result-expecting calls run on their own task; P1-F8 `register`, `register_async`, `register_typed` and `remove` take `impl Into<String>`. Re-review repairs: P1-F9 result calls start inline in arrival order; P1-F10 native callbacks are `Send + Sync` and run without a lock; P1-F11 docs.

Review repairs: P1-F2 the reply sink follows the logical connection (stateful resume keeps it; `client-result-errors` completes a result after a forced resume on every target); P1-F4 byte-level error-Completion tests; P1-F6 the native second-completion assertion runs in the scenario; P1-F7 a panicking callback answers with its message. Re-review repairs: P1-F2 a logical-connection counter makes replies after an ordinary reconnect fail locally (`client-result-errors` covers both reconnect kinds); P1-F12 a panic answers only an otherwise unanswered call.
